decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template is cheap to keep and still supports shop-hosting customers, but it has not been visible since 2018 and may be quietly retired as templates age.
The responsive template costs little to maintain and helps agencies start projects, though its visibility has faded and it could be replaced by newer starter offerings.
Premium support embodies the firm's core differentiator of expert round-the-clock service and generates recurring extra revenue from agencies.
The version management tool is part of the platform's toolset that reduces developers' recurring work, so it remains strategically relevant.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and focus of its strategic direction, so it will be developed further rather than withdrawn.
